etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: Borrowing from French cérébral, from Latin cerebrum (“a brain”); equivalent to cerebrum +‎ -al.
senses: (anatomy, relational) Of or relating to the brain, cerebrum, or cerebral cortex.
Intellectual rather than emotional or physical.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: Semantic loan from Sanskrit मूर्धन्य (mūrdhanya, “pertaining to the head”).
